Topic 3.8: Reading three to four letter words

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading three to four letter words. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do we blend syllables (3 HRS) form three to four letter to make words?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Read three to four letter small groups. words correctly in and out • Learners could be of class. involved in a variety of activities to read three to
